events.verdict: After the shot fake, Antetokounmpo (MIL) slides his pivot foot before the step through during his shot attempt.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) brings his left arm upward and marginal contact occurs with Wagner's (ORL) arm as Antetokounmpo releases the pass.
Banchero (ORL) fails to fully clear the lane and is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.

Caldwell-Pope (ORL) moves alongside Lillard's (MIL) path and marginal body contact occurs as they come together during the driving shot attempt. This contact occurs before Caldwell-Pope cleanly blocks the layup attempt.
Anthony (ORL) releases the inbounds pass in under 5 seconds.

Replay review of the out of bounds called on Caldwell-Pope (ORL) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Replay Review shows Caldwell-Pope blocks the layup attempt, but Lillard (MIL) is the last to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Porter Jr. (MIL) brushes Carter Jr.'s (ORL) arm as he defends Carter Jr.'s shot attempt near the rim.
Caldwell-Pope (ORL) reaches for the ball and initiates illegal contact with Antetokounmpo's (MIL) arm as he defends his play at the basket.

Prince (MIL) makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it away from Anthony (ORL) prior to incidental arm contact occurring. The contact that occurs as both players pursue the loose ball is incidental.
Lillard (MIL) gathers the ball on his right foot and takes two steps before releasing his jump shot attempt
Caldwell-Pope (ORL) deflects Lillard's (MIL) pass out of bounds. Possession is correctly awarded to MIL.
Wagner (ORL) contests the jump shot attempt and avoids making contact with Lillard (MIL).
